verdicts_or_reports.element: Steel Full Helmet sell row / Snackbar guard message
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Steel Full Helmet is not equipped anymore (Combat > Gear > Head shows Mithril Med Helmet), so tapping its Sell row should open the sell-quantity sheet like any other unequipped item, and it should be eligible for the Sell Old Gear bulk action. The item should only be blocked/marked equipped while it is actually in the Head slot.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Tapping the unequipped Steel Full Helmet row does nothing and shows "Steel Full Helmet is equipped. Unequip it first to sell." The row itself does not display "(equipped)", yet the guard still treats it as equipped, and the item is also omitted from the Sell Old Gear candidate list.
steps: Open Combat > Gear > Head and equip Steel Full Helmet.
Tap the Head slot again and equip Mithril Med Helmet, replacing Steel Full Helmet.
Confirm the Head slot now shows Mithril Med Helmet (Steel Full Helmet is unequipped).
Open Shop > Sell, search "Steel Full Helmet" and tap its row.
Observe the snackbar "Steel Full Helmet is equipped. Unequip it first to sell."
verdicts_or_reports.observed_quote: Steel Full Helmet is equipped. Unequip it first to sell.

contains: Steel Full Helmet is equipped. Unequip it first to sell.

harness_replies: Developer: could not reproduce with the steps given.
